verdict.rationale: Agent governance is a fair axis for GitHub, which ships Copilot agents, but the pack never documents admins enabling or disabling agents per organization, group, or instance, or setting allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit. The individual-account Copilot settings page (github-docs-53) is not group or instance control. The Ask/Agent mode dropdown is a user chat mode, not a policy. Fine-grained PAT permissions govern API tokens, not agent tool use.
